segments.text: Shirou is a good-hearted and honest teenager who always enjoys helping others. He is raised by Emiya Kiritsugu, who imparts to him fundamental sorcery and "The Ally of Justice" ideal. He is in his second year of High School, and his hobbies include fixing various broken things, from VCRs to stoves, as well as cooking and cleaning.

Shirou is unskilled in most traditional forms of sorcery. He only knows Reinforcement, the power to analyze objects' structural composition to increase their effectiveness, such as the sharpness and durability of a sword and shield.
Edited from Wikipedia
The servant of Matou Sakura.
Rider is quiet and prefers solitary activities such as reading and swimming.

cast.characterName: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ
cast.originalCharacterName: バゼット・フラガ・マクレミッツ

segments.text: A mage sent from the Mage's Association to fight the 5th War of the Holy Grail, born in Ireland as a descendant of old mage family of an unusual bloodline. She is mentioned very briefly in Fate/stay night.
The original Master of Lancer, she was betrayed by Kotomine Kirei and became the master of the Servant Avenger.
From Wikipedia
Saber is Shirou's Servant. Loyal, independent, and reserved, Saber acts coldly but is actually suppressing her emotions to focus on her goals.

Her class is considered the "Most Outstanding" with excellent ratings in all categories. Since her Master cannot adequately provide her with Mana, she minimizes her activity to preserve her energy. Saber is frustrated by Shirou's "protective" tendencies, believing his erratic and reckless behavior will jeopardize her chances of winning the Holy Grail War.
Her real name is
Artoria Pendragon/Altria Pendragon, the legendary King Arthur.
From Wikipedia

Rin is a model student and idol of Shirou's school. She barely talks to other students in her school and exhibits a desire to be left alone, as exemplified by her tendency to stay on the school's rooftop, away from the rest of the students.

She is also secretly a magus and a Master in the Holy Grail War. Rin is reared as the successor to her family's magecraft, instructed by her father, Toosaka Tokiomi, to prioritize sorcery over her own interests. After her father is killed, Rin continues to perfect her sorcery, with some guidance from Kotomine Kirei.

She strives to earn the admiration of her peers to avoid drawing attention to her private life, even though she is secretly stingy, tomboyish, and a slacker. She is sharp, resourceful, and avidly competitive.
From Wikipedia
She also appears in Fate/Extra CCC as a hidden, optional boss. This is not to be confused with the Toosaka Rin in the same game.
A student in her first year of high school and the sister of Matou Shinji. After Shirou's father Kiritsugu died, Sakura often visited Shirou's home to help him with his daily chores.
Though Shinji is from a family of sorcerers, he asserts that she does not know her family's craft or history.
Sakura is outwardly timid but possesses high inner strength. She has a long-standing crush on Shirou.
From Wikipedia

A mysterious warrior of unspecified origins and era who serves as the Servant to Toosaka Rin. Exuding a palpable aura of cynicism and sarcasm, Archer's worldview starkly contrasts with that of Shirou's, whose idealistic and naive aspiration to 'save everyone' he perceives as an unattainable folly.

Archer is Emiya Shirou from a possible future, a magus specializing in psychometry and object replication with a focus on swords. Though his replicas may be weaker, he can enhance them to surpass even the originals. In addition, true to his talent since his youth, his unparalleled marksmanship complements his magical prowess, making him a formidable and versatile combatant.
Edited from Wikipedia
He also appears as an optional boss in Fate/Extra CCC. This is not to be confused with the playable Archer in that same game.

cast.originalCharacterName: イリヤスフィール・フォン・アインツベルン

segments.text: A Teutonic aristocrat, she traveled to Japan to participate in the Holy Grail War as a Master. Illyasviel is a young girl with an unprecedented degree of magical power. Illyasviel asks those she feels comfortable around to simply call her "Ilya".
She lives in a castle on the outskirts of Fuyuki City, accompanied only by her Servant and two maids.
Edited from Wikipedia

Lancer is a fierce but fair warrior who enjoys combating a worthy opponent. He has a playful attitude and takes a carefree approach to life but quickly works himself into a frenzy during a heated battle.
Lancers are hailed as the "Most Agile" of Servant classes. Lancer's weapon, the Gáe Bolg, is a cursed spear that can inflict wounds that do not heal as long as the spear remains in the world.
Edited from Wikipedia
A formidable warrior, standing tall with skin almost impenetrable by anything less than the finest weapons. He wields a massive ax sword, capable of wreaking havoc with each powerful swing.

As a Berserker, he has lost his sanity and reason, behaving wildly in combat. Berserkers are esteemed as members of the "Strongest" class, but their lack of rationality makes them notoriously difficult to control and prone to turning on their Masters. Despite this, Ilya has complete control over Berserker, keeping him in check.
Berserker's Noble Phantasm, "Godhand," grants him the ability to self-resurrect up to eleven times. This means that it will take twelve kills to defeat Berserker permanently.
Edited from Wikipedia
Matou Sakura's older brother, and a long-time friend of Shirou. Shinji is very popular as vice-captain of the archery club despite being chauvinistic and a narcissist.
Like Toosaka Rin, he is of a distinguished lineage of sorcerers, though the Matou blood has thinned and no longer produces heirs naturally capable of sorcery.
Shinji feels uncomfortable with his sister's daily visits to Shirou's home. He has an open crush on Rin, but she does not return his favors.
Edited from Wikipedia
Otoko works at and is the daughter of the owner of Copenhagen. Otoko went to school with and is friends with both Taiga and Reikan.

cast.characterName: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト
cast.originalCharacterName: ルヴィアゼリッタ・エーデルフェルト

segments.text: Luvia is a young head of the distinguished Finnish lineage of magi, Edelfelt. She tries to look like elegant lady, but lose that image quickly, when Tohsaka Rin approaches her. During the 3rd Holy Grail War the masters of Edelfelts were defeated by master of Tohsaka's lineage, so starting from the first encounter at Clock Tower dorm, Rin and Luvia became principal rivals in every way.
Luvia is surprisingly a fan of wrestling, which makes her a dangerous opponent. And she's found of Shiro, whom she happened to meet in London.

Avenger was an ordinary villager. One day, he was randomly chosen as the "source of all evil in the world" by his village and was tortured and sacrificed in the ensuing rituals. The villagers, who were suffering from various disasters, eventually came to need a scapegoat for blaming their troubles onto. So they continuously tortured him until he went insane. They captured him, beat him, carved every word that cursed mankind onto his body, forced every sin imaginable upon him, took out bits and pieces of him slowly, defiled his mind with absolute evil, and held him responsible for all of it in the world.

He was summoned in the Holy Third Grail War by the Einzbern family. The only Avenger Class Servant summoned was during the Third Holy Grail War, and rather than a true Heroic Spirit, an Anti-Hero was summoned. He was quickly killed in four days and was trapped in the wish-granting spiritual Holy Grail. His influence tainted the Grail system. Originally the Grail system can summon only "good" Heroic Spirits, however due to his corruption caused the fourth and fifth Wars to summon irregular spirits.
In Fate/hollow ataraxia, he forms a contract with Bazett Fraga McRemitz after Kirei Kotomine betrays her and steals the Command Seals of Lancer. He later encounters Caren Hortensia, Kirei's daughter.
Reikan is the older brother of Issei and is a monk at the Ryuudou Temple. Reikan went to school with and is friends with both Taiga and Otoko.
Minori is the younger brother of Ayako and is two grades below her. He is also in the archery club and has a crush on Sakura.
Ruby is a sentient Kaleidostick that harnesses the power of the Second Magic to transform its wielder into a magical girl.
Stheno is the eldest of the three Gorgon sisters.
Stheno and Euryale would frequently team-up and bully Medusa about her larger size. Medusa eventually devoured both Stheno and Euryale.
Euryale is the second eldest of the three Gorgon sisters.
Euryale and Stheno would frequently team-up and bully Medusa about her larger size. Medusa eventually devoured both Euryale and Stheno.
Sella is one of Illyasviel's maids and also acts as her teacher. Sella is strict and difficult to please.
Leysritt is a combat-specialized homunculus that is one of Illyasviel's maids. Leysritt is blunt, but has trouble communicating.
A younger version of Gilgamesh who took this form due to drinking a potion that de-aged him.
Yukika is close friends with Kaede and Kane. Yukika comes from a poor family and has a patient and caring personality.
A friend of Rin and talented sprinter. Makidera is loud, energetic, and rarely seen away from her close friends Yukika and Kane.
Kane is close friends with Kaede and Saegusa. Kane has a quiet and serious personality.

Through an agreement between the Mages' Association and the Church, the Holy Grail Wars are moderated by a priest. Kirei's father was the mediator for the fourth Holy Grail War, and when he died, Kirei felt obligated to replace him. His selection as a mediator is unusual, for Kirei is a member of both the Church and Mages' Association, organizations on hostile terms with one another.
Since the death of Rin's father, he has acted as an indirect caretaker for Rin.
Ranked far lower in the Church hierarchy than Ciel (from Tsukihime), Kirei employs many of the same techniques and weapons she does.
He is surprisingly convincing as a magus, having trained under Rin's father.
Edited from Wikipedia

Fujimura Taiga is an English teacher at Shirou's school, homeroom instructor of Shirou's class and the supervising teacher for the archery club. She is widely called "Tiger", a nickname she dislikes ("Taiga" and "Tiger" sound similar in Japanese), though Shirou refers to her as "Fuji-nee" (older sister Fuji).
After Kiritsugu died, Taiga became Shirou's guardian and has been living with him for several years. Taiga and Shirou are very close, and she regards him as a younger brother.
Edited from Wikipedia

Kuzuki Souichirou is the strict homeroom instructor of Rin's class. He primarily lectures on World History, though he also holds classes in Ethics. A well-built man with angular glasses, Kuzuki is well respected among staff and students, but he is widely regarded as austere and impersonal.
Edited from Wikipedia

An honored guest of the Ryuudou family permitted to live at their temple until the preparations for her marriage have been finalized. A gorgeous and talented yet mysterious woman of high stature, her presence has attracted the attention of many trainee monks.
She is a Caster-class Servant, who is an expert in using ancient thaumaturgy.
Her real name is Medea
Edited from Wikipedia
An arrogant, selfish, and enigmatic Archer-class Servant. He appears familiar with Fuyuki City and has an unrequited love for Saber.

Typically clad in ornate golden armor, he possesses countless prototypes of other heroes' Noble Phantasms inside his Gate of Babylon. Still, only two (besides Gate of Babylon itself) are truly representative of his true identity.
Edited from Wikipedia

Ryuudou Issei is the Student Body President of Homurabara Highschool, and a close friend of Emiya Shirou. Issei often asks Shirou to fix broken equipment for the Student Body to try and reduce save money on the school's bill. Issei and Shirou often have lunch together in the Student Body's office where they talk about what ever comes to mind.

His father is the head priest of Ryuudouji Temple, and his brother was a classmate of Taiga and Neko-san. He dislikes Toosaka Rin and seems to have some sort of fear of females, although he seems to be unusually at ease around Saber.
Edited from Wikipedia
Clothed in a traditional Japanese umanori hakama and kimono with an indigo haori, this handsome Servant
bars entry beyond the main gate of the Ryuudouji Temple.
Quiet and composed, he maintains a degree of bushido and is eager to spar with other Servants.
Although he has the same class, he is not to be confused with another Servant known as True Assassin.
His real name is
Sasaki Kojirou
Edited from Wikipedia
Zouken is a shrewd, powerful, but ancient sorcerer who is patriarch of the Matou family and is known to be the grandfather of Shinji and Sakura.

He has amassed a large and extensive library of sorcerous knowledge, yet his lessons are strict and harsh. Zouken considers Shinji to be a disgrace of a sorcerer, and believes Sakura may have more potential than her brother.
From Wikipedia

A stellar athlete, and captain of the archery club. Ayako and Rin are friends and actively competing to see who will be the first to snag a boyfriend. Ayako is also friends with Shirou and has a one-sided rivalry with him.
From Wikipedia

Once Sakura rejects Zouken's control and regains her central consciousness, she becomes Dark Sakura, a rancorous and psychotic distortion of her normal self. In this form, her reasoning and emotions are severely impaired and she is indiscriminately destructive to everything around her.
Edited from Typemoon Wikia

segments.text: When Saber is consumed by The Shadow, she turns into Sakura's Servant, Saber Alter, a corrupted version of her former self with unmatched strength.
Edited from Typemoon Wikia

cast.originalCharacterName: カレン・オルテンシア

segments.text: The main heroine of this game, Caren is a member of the Church and she works as a priestess. She is kind and forgiving to the point that she believes her only purpose in life is to help others, even if she is hurt in the process. She never blames the person who has hurt her and blames the act on demons who caused the person to commit the sin. Whenever she is at fault, she apologizes to God rather than the person. Despite her kindness, she has a love for teasing and exploiting others’ emotional vulnerability. Upon discovery of an individual’s weak spot, she enjoys bringing it out to light in front of all to witness. While this antagonizes many characters and causes much outrage and humiliation, she remains calm. Also, in spite of being a priestess, she has deliberately chosen to wear a revealing costume with no skirt to both increase her mobility and to seduce men.
From Wikipedia
